Who's behind it

Driven by precision.
Built for performance.

FNS Designs bridges the gap between high-level mechanical engineering and competitive sim racing. Founded by Athanasios Antonios, every peripheral is designed from the ground up using topology optimization, custom embedded firmware and rapid additive manufacturing — built for relentless feedback, durability and immersion.

  • 100% in-house R&D — every part is modeled in Fusion 360, run through structural stress analysis, and printed on high-precision CoreXY machines.
  • Plug-and-play compatibility — recognized natively as a standard USB HID controller, no drivers or extra setup. Works with Assetto Corsa, iRacing, DiRT Rally and BeamNG.drive.
  • Open to custom modding — designed by engineers, for enthusiasts. Easy to disassemble, maintain and integrate into your own rig.
Rig hardware

Sim racing gear

Clamp-mount hardware designed for real cockpits — every piece here mounts equally well to a desk edge, a rig, or a wheel stand. Printed in tough engineering plastics and tuned by hand before they go out the door.

How it's made

Designed, then printed

Every part starts as a CAD model, gets tested on the bench, and is revised before it becomes a product — the generative-design handbrake above went through several structural passes before final print.

Model

CAD first

Every part is modeled and dimensioned in Fusion 360 before a single layer gets printed.

Slice

Additive by design

Every part is oriented, support-generated and sliced for FDM printing before it ever touches the nozzle.

Print

Off the plate

Straight off the printer with supports still on, before anything gets cleaned up or fitted.

Wire

Chips & sensors

RP2040 controllers wired to their sensors and prepped before they go into a shell.

Solder

Wired by hand

Hall-effect sensor leads soldered and strain-relieved before final assembly.

More from the bench as parts come off the printer and the soldering iron.

From the shop floor

Watch it come together

Short clips from the bench — printing, wiring and assembly, straight from the shop.
